# Generated by OrchestKit Claude Plugin
# Created: 2026-09-02
#
# hspell false-positive allowlist for spellcheck-candidates.py
# (Phase 0 spike / Phase 1 plan, "Research digest" section).
#
# hspell 1.4's Academy-of-the-Hebrew-Language dictionary rejects a class of
# legitimate modern-Hebrew ktiv male (full spelling) words that are in
# everyday academic use. Measured over a ~6,600-token sample article
# (~2,600 unique tokens): of 60 unique hspell flags, ~20 were this
# ktiv-male false-positive class -- the same failure mode independently
# observed elsewhere for Mishnaic/DSS orthography rejected by the same
# Academy dictionary, there via period spelling, here via modern ktiv
# male. One token per line; blank lines and lines starting with '#' are
# ignored. Matched after niqqud-stripping and geresh/gershayim-to-ASCII
# mapping, so list tokens plain, without niqqud.
#
# Project-specific additions belong in .academic-helper/hspell-allowlist.txt
# (per-project extension file, unioned with this list, never edited here).

#
# INCLUSION RULE (added 2026-09-02 after a seeding error): a token belongs here
# ONLY if it is unambiguously correct modern academic Hebrew that hspell wrongly
# rejects. A DEFICIENT pre-2017 spelling never belongs here, even though hspell
# flags it -- that is a genuine error the proofread finder is meant to fix as a
# word-level correction. Removed on that basis: האשה, הדוגמא, נסיונותיהם (the
# post-reform forms are ניסיונותיהם / האישה / הדוגמה). Allowlisting them hid three
# real finds behind a list meant to hide noise.
